planets.name: TOI-5786 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5786 with a 12.8-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5786 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5786. Its orbit and size follow Thomas et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
